# MacSolid Systems

> High-performance CAD assembly inspection, multi-threaded STEP/IGES parsing, and automated Bill of Materials (BOM) extraction engine.

## Product Overview
MacSolid (also known as Part Separator) is an independent engineering CAD software platform built for mechanical engineers, CNC machine shops, sheet metal estimators, and manufacturing enterprises. It enables 60 FPS GPU cross-section cutting, hierarchy component isolation, raw stock bounding envelope sizing, and 1-click ERP/Excel BOM exports without requiring expensive primary CAD licenses (SolidWorks, NX, CATIA).

## Core Capabilities
- **Multi-Threaded C++ STEP Engine**: Parses multi-part assemblies with thousands of unique bodies in seconds.
- **60 FPS GPU Section Studio**: Real-time capped solid clipping along cardinal axes with precision coordinate measurement [X, Y, Z].
- **Automated BOM & Raw Stock**: Automatic envelope calculation for plate, bar, and round stock with custom machining and kerf allowances.
- **Sheet Metal Recognition**: Automatic gauge thickness detection and flat blank boundary analysis.
- **Secure Air-Gapped Deployment**: Available for offline workstation operations with zero telemetry.

## Available Editions
- **MacSolid Lite**: 3D CAD viewer, orbit, pan, measurement, and cut-plane inspection.
- **MacSolid Standard**: Full automated BOM engine, raw stock calculation, and ERP spreadsheet export.
- **MacSolid Professional**: Custom ERP integration schemas, machinery kerf tailoring, proprietary rules, and LAN floating licenses.
